name: Elishaphat
title: Commander under Jehoiada
summary: Elishaphat, son of Zikri, was one of the military leaders (captains of hundreds) whom the priest Jehoiada allied with to carry out the coup against Queen Athaliah and install the rightful king Joash on Judah's throne. He played a crucial role in protecting the Davidic dynasty during a critical period.

keyEvents.title: Jehoiada's covenant with the captains of hundreds
keyEvents.description: The priest Jehoiada made a covenant with the captains of hundreds, including Elishaphat son of Zikri, to overthrow Queen Athaliah and restore the Davidic kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Assembly of Levites and Family Heads
keyEvents.description: Eliashib and the other captains of a hundred went throughout Judah, gathering the Levites and family heads to carry out the plan to install Joash as king.

keyEvents.title: Covenant in God's House
keyEvents.description: The entire assembly made a covenant with the young King Joash in God's house, where Jehoiada reminded them that the king's son was to reign as the Lord had promised concerning the descendants of David.

keyEvents.title: Organizing Temple Guard Duty
keyEvents.description: Eliashib and the other leaders organized the guard duty so that one-third of the priests and Levites stood watch at the doors, one-third at the king's house, and one-third at the Foundation Gate.

keyEvents.title: The Coronation of Joash
keyEvents.description: Under the protection of Eliashib and the other captains of a hundred, the young Joash was crowned and anointed as king over Judah, and the people shouted, "Long live the king!"

keyEvents.title: The Fall of Athaliah
keyEvents.description: When Queen Athaliah heard the shouts of joy and discovered the coup, she was led out of the temple. Jehoiada ordered the captains of a hundred, including Eliashib, to take her out and kill all who followed her.
